title: Check entity identity presence and uniqueness
description: Check that every entity in a declared candidate model scope has an explicit nonempty identity and that distinct entities have distinct identities. Report identity presence and uniqueness separately from broader model-format or reference validation.
inputs: The selected governed model state or proposed resulting state.
The entity definitions and declared scope whose identities are to be checked.
outputs: Identity findings identifying missing identities or identities shared by distinct entities.
The checked scope and whether identity checking is complete for that scope.
behavior: Check that each entity has an explicit nonempty identity.
Compare identities across the declared model scope independently of display names, entity types, and physical locations.
Report any identity assigned to distinct entities as a conflict in the candidate state.
Allow equal display names when identities remain distinct.
Report a model-wide identity conclusion only when the complete governed scope needed for that conclusion has been checked.

failure_behavior.condition: An entity definition cannot be inspected or part of the declared model scope is unavailable.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the incomplete check and available findings without claiming model-wide uniqueness.

failure_behavior.condition: An identity is absent or assigned to distinct entities.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the offending definitions and report the candidate state as invalid for identity purposes.

sources.basis: SR-002 requires explicit identities and rejection of duplicate identities within one governed model, independently of name, type, and location.
